hypothesis: Dropping the fixed penalty indicator frees a feature for independently fitting singleton masking. Batch size and empty-history cardinality retain the dominant penalty predictors, while separate masking indicators avoid imposing an inaccurate cost ratio.

pcvs.name: penalty_batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Captures the dominant batch-dependent penalty cost.

pcvs.name: requests_without_output
pcvs.rationale: Retains the feature consistently associated with substantially better penalty attribution.

pcvs.expression: int(sampling_metadata.no_penalties and sum((len(getattr(processor, 'logits_slice', ([], []))[0]) for processor in sampling_metadata.logitsprocs.non_argmax_invariant)) > 0)
pcvs.name: unpenalized_mask_active
pcvs.rationale: Separately captures activation of masking in unpenalized calls.

pcvs.expression: int(sampling_metadata.no_penalties and sum((len(getattr(processor, 'logits_slice', ([], []))[0]) for processor in sampling_metadata.logitsprocs.non_argmax_invariant)) == 1)
pcvs.name: unpenalized_single_mask
pcvs.rationale: Allows an independent contribution for the more expensive singleton masking case.
